column1: # c4ql-casts.tsv -- which table a C4QL cast word points at; read by bin/tg1rs (the tag resolver).
# A tool table: tg1rs reads it back in its answers.  Guide: conventions/C4QL-TAG.md.
# Columns (tab-separated): cast, table, key, kind, by.
#   table: ws:PATH (this garden), c4:PATH (the C4 tree), seat:PATH (the memory seat), cast:NAME (indirect), or a plain path.
#   key:   the column number(s) that make the row key, joined by ":" ("-" for store and file kinds).
#   kind:  tsv | words (space-separated, read case-blind) | file (PATH/FACT.md) | store (PATH/FACT/g*.md) | indirect | alias | names (the persons sweep may take from a "by" column).
#   by:    the column that names who wrote or influenced the row ("-" = none).  An alias row lists the persons it stands for.
